solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: The compiler's style faces charge it's extravagant

indicators.note: style faces charge means the style word stands in front of the charge word

parts.note: the setter speaking of himself: 'the compiler is' becomes I'M
a style or manner is a mode
a charge or fee is a rate

explanation.surface: A setter boasts that his own way of pricing things is lavish.
explanation.definitionFit: Something extravagant goes beyond reasonable limits, which is to say excessive or unrestrained.

clue.text: Goddess lives and lives again

parts.note: lives in the sense of exists, as in 'he is'
the same verb again, exists

explanation.surface: A deity who lives, dies, and lives once more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' and 'again' simply join the two copies of the same verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Isis was the chief mother goddess of ancient Egyptian religion.

clue.text: Having grown most bananas?

parts.note: reads like a plantation record, but bananas is slang for crazy, so most bananas means craziest

explanation.definitionFit: Bananas is informal for mad, so the superlative of being bananas is the superlative of mad.

clue.text: Dispatch riot patrols for absolute rule

indicators.note: patrols move around their beat, so the letters of the two words are moved around

explanation.surface: Sending riot police on patrol is the mark of a despotic regime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'patrols' looks like more fodder but is the anagram signal; the letters of DISPATCH and RIOT are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A dictatorship is government by one ruler with unlimited power, i.e. absolute rule.

clue.text: Call up, armed off and on with arm?

indicators.note: taking letters off and on means alternate letters: here the second and fourth of the word armed

parts.note: an arm is an example of a limb, or member, hence the question mark

explanation.surface: A puzzling account of a limb being removed and then reattached.
explanation.walkthrough: The even letters of 'armed' give RE; the question mark flags that arm is only one kind of member.
explanation.definitionFit: To call up a memory is to recall it, bringing something past back to mind.

clue.text: Resident of wigwam sheltering a native leader

indicators.note: the tent shelters, or holds within it, the other letters

parts.note: a wigwam is a type of tent

indicators.note: the leader of native is its first letter

explanation.surface: A Native American chief is staying inside a wigwam.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenant is an occupant who lives in a property rented from someone else.

clue.text: Fastener is forced at front of piano

indicators.note: one piece sits in front of the other

parts.note: as in 'has to': he has to go means he is forced to go
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

explanation.surface: A clasp on a piano lid has been forced open.
explanation.definitionFit: A hasp is a hinged metal plate fitting over a staple and secured with a padlock.

clue.text: Grow old under state routine

indicators.note: in a down clue the second piece sits under the first

parts.note: to state firmly is to aver
to grow old is to age

explanation.surface: Getting older is just a fact of life under any government.
explanation.definitionFit: Routine as an adjective means ordinary or typical, exactly what average means.

clue.text: Joke of Labour leader accepted by working class

indicators.note: the working-class word takes in, or accepts, the extra letter

parts.note: the peasantry are the class of agricultural workers

indicators.note: the leader of Labour is its first letter

explanation.surface: A Labour leader's gag goes down well with blue-collar voters.
explanation.walkthrough: Labour is the UK's main left-of-centre party.
explanation.definitionFit: A pleasantry is a light, amusing remark or joke made in conversation.

clue.text: Italy with new leader, people tense for stimulus

parts.note: I is the international vehicle code for Italy
Il Duce, the leader, was Mussolini's title
people, as in staff, are men
T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: Italy under a new leader and a nervy population is ripe for change.
explanation.definitionFit: An inducement is an incentive that prompts action, the same idea as a stimulus.

clue.text: Fair chance, some say

indicators.note: signals that the word is spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: chance, or fortune, is fate

explanation.surface: Winning at a funfair is just luck, people claim.
explanation.definitionFit: A fete is an outdoor fair, typically held to raise funds for a local cause.

clue.text: Feeling virtually sick?

parts.note: virtually here means not in reality: a sickness that exists only in the mind

explanation.definitionFit: Hypochondria is the persistent belief that one is ill when one is not, an imagined illness.

clue.text: Star's very mature in comeback

indicators.note: coming back means the word is read backwards

parts.note: to mature is to age

explanation.surface: An ageing celebrity is staging a return to the limelight.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's ageing film star is misleading: the definition is a real star in the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: Vega is the brightest star in the constellation Lyra.

clue.text: Fat cats perhaps as bogymen in disguise

indicators.note: a disguise alters appearance, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Wealthy executives cast as villains in masks.
explanation.definitionFit: Moneybags is a slang term for a rich person, and fat cats are wealthy businesspeople.

clue.text: Cursed sailor with old bird nearly exhausted

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor
mina is a variant spelling of the myna, a starling-like bird

indicators.note: nearly means stop short, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: bled, as in drained or bled dry

explanation.surface: Echoes the Ancient Mariner: the cursed sailor with the albatross, nearly spent.
explanation.definitionFit: Abominable means detestable or accursed, something loathed and execrated.

clue.text: Closed end, done, undone

parts.note: a butt is the thick end of something, as of a cigarette or rifle

indicators.note: undone means taken apart, so the word's letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The matter is closed, finished, done and dusted, or perhaps not.
explanation.definitionFit: A coat that is buttoned is fastened shut, i.e. closed up.

clue.text: Reign is finished within borders of Gabon

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other
the borders of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: something finished is over

explanation.surface: A ruler's time in the African state of Gabon has come to an end.
explanation.definitionFit: To reign is to rule as monarch, which is to govern a country.

clue.text: Sharp detectives can concoct case

parts.note: DIs are detective inspectors
a tin is a can

indicators.note: the case of a word is its outer letters

explanation.surface: Clever detectives can fabricate a case against a suspect.
explanation.definitionFit: Distinct means clearly defined, as a sharp image or outline is.

clue.text: Irritate majority embracing the French

indicators.note: one word wraps round the other

parts.note: the majority is most of them
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Most people are annoyed by the French.
explanation.definitionFit: To molest in its older sense is to pester or annoy, i.e. irritate.

clue.text: Unusually tactile aid for climbers?

indicators.note: unusually means arranged in an odd way, signalling rearrangement

explanation.surface: A rock-climbing aid that is unexpectedly pleasant to the touch.
explanation.walkthrough: The climbers are not mountaineers but climbing plants, as the question mark hints.
explanation.definitionFit: A lattice or trellis supports climbing plants such as roses and ivy.

clue.text: More powerful fighter with hard row

parts.note: a MiG is a Russian fighter plane
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard
a tier is a row, as of seats

explanation.surface: A stronger boxer emerges from a tough argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' wants to be a quarrel; it is a row of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: Mightier means stronger, the comparative of mighty, powerful.

clue.text: National and international leader stood with Scot

indicators.note: the leader of international is its first letter

parts.note: to stand for election is to run, so stood is ran
Ian is a typical Scottish name

explanation.surface: A Scottish politician stood beside a world leader.
explanation.definitionFit: A national here is a citizen of a country, an Iranian being a citizen of Iran.

clue.text: Where a happy medium may be found?

definitions.text: Where a happy medium may be found?

parts.words: Where a happy medium may be found?
parts.note: a happy medium is a compromise, but here it is a cheerful spiritualist at work

explanation.definitionFit: A seance is a gathering at which a spiritualist medium tries to contact the dead.

clue.text: Food fanatic before term in stir

indicators.note: the first piece stands before the second

parts.note: a nut is an enthusiast or fanatic

indicators.note: to stir is to mix, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Prison food: a crazed inmate begins his sentence in jail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stir' looks like prison slang, but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Nutriment is nourishment, any substance that feeds the body.

clue.text: Not exactly awfully remote initially

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of each of the preceding words

explanation.surface: Something close by is not, strictly speaking, far away.
explanation.definitionFit: Near means close by, not exactly distant, which the whole clue describes.

clue.text: Oath for example followed by a Democrat leader

indicators.note: the first piece is followed by the rest
the leader of Democrat is its first letter

explanation.surface: A swear word let slip, followed by a Democratic leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Egad is an old-fashioned mild oath, a euphemism for 'by God'.

clue.text: Start to bathe with lotion for skin inflammation

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

parts.note: oil is a lotion rubbed on the skin

explanation.surface: Take a bath with a soothing lotion to treat a skin complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: A boil is a painful, pus-filled swelling of the skin.

clue.text: Angler's in mess gripping pole getting tangled

indicators.note: the jumbled letters grip, or surround, the extra letter
in a mess means jumbled, signalling an anagram

parts.note: N is the North Pole

explanation.surface: A fisherman's line is in a tangle round his rod.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pole' wants to be the fishing rod; it is N, north.
explanation.definitionFit: Ensnarling means entangling, tangling up as in a snare.

clue.text: First lady? Queen, always

parts.note: Eve was the first woman, in Genesis
R is short for regina, queen

explanation.surface: The President's wife and the Queen are forever together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First lady' suggests a US President's wife; it is Eve.
explanation.definitionFit: Ever means at all times, the same as always.

clue.text: Showered after snooze to get sober

indicators.note: the showered word goes after the snooze word

parts.note: a snooze is a rest
showered as in it rained

explanation.surface: A shower after a nap to sober up.
explanation.definitionFit: Restrained means controlled and moderate, which is what sober can mean.
